title: Highly sensitive electrochemical detection of hazardous 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine using MgCo-TiO2/g-C3N4 heterostructure nanocomposites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45855-45873
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07106B, Paper

In this study, MgCo-TiO2/g-C3N4 heterostructure nanocomposites were successfully synthesized for the electrochemical detection of 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine.
